decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed single-storey rear extension to cafe would be compatible with the appearance of the building, would not harm the living conditions of adjoining neighbours or the servicing arrangements of the commercial parade. The development therefore complies with adopted Unitary Development Plan policy ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and T 1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is used.

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The proposal shall not be commenced until a scheme for the ventilation of the proposed kitchen of an appropriate outlet level, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and the standard or dilution expected has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 7 - The extension hereby permitted shall only be used in connection with the existing ground floor caf? of the premises known as 443 Great West Road Hounslow.

Condition : 8 - The site shall be investigated for landfill gas to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority and details of the test results and measures required to render the development safe shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced.

Where measures are required, they shall be installed before the development is occupied or such other time as may be required by the Local Planning Authority
description: Erection of a single storey garage, store and toilet facility to rear of cafe.
